text:
maria: Ran a targeted sweep this morning on 16xA100 with a 'staccato' microbatch config. Observing a persistent all-reduce tail during the PP bubble that grows with microbatch size. quick notes attached.

perf-bot: Profiling snapshot (node-3):
```
cmd: ./rprof --task=pp -n 200 --trace=kernel-selection
timeline: compute: 82ms | allreduce: 31ms | idle: 18ms
kv_cache: spill=0.9% prefetch=2.1%
```

aj: Can you paste the exact schedule, microbatch sizes, and the runtime flags you used?

maria: config: `microbatch=8`, `1f1b=true`, `prefetch_window=1`, `kern_select=auto`. Repro script: 
```
runtest --model=gpt-7b --pp=4 --tp=2 --mb=8 --trace=timeline --kv-prefetch=1
```

tom: Looks like `kern_select=auto` is falling back to a generic matmul at seq length ~512. I saw similar when odd seq boundaries hit the optimized kernels. Try `kern_select=streamed-gemm` or force `matmul_kernel=v2`.

kelly: Also check KV cache alignment — if `prefetch_window < microbatch` we saw extra NVLink transfers between pipeline stages. That added ~12-18ms tail in earlier runs.

aj: Did you capture comm/compute overlap? My hunch: allreduce isn't overlapping because NVLink/CUDA streams are mis-assigned and the reduction starts late.

maria: full step trace (per-step ms):
```
forward_compute: 68, allreduce: 22 (starts at +55), kv-prefetch: 10 (starts at +5), idle: 25
note: allreduce end drifts past next forward start in 3/10 steps
```

tom: If allreduce drifts we should: push KV prefetch earlier, reduce `microbatch` to 6, or increase `prefetch_window` to 2. Also experiment with `allreduce_async=true` (experimental) and `kern_select=streamed-gemm`.

kelly: Caveat on `allreduce_async` — it reduced median but increased tail variance on host-5 last week. Maybe combine with `kern_select=streamed-gemm` which reduced compute stalls for us.

aj: Can you run 50-step perf with `--trace=commcompute` and `--kern_override=streamed-gemm` on the same pool? That will show overlap heatmaps.

maria: kicking that now, ping when it's done.

perf-bot: Job queued 2755554330, nodes used: 16, ETA ~12m.

maria: results: with `streamed-gemm` + `prefetch=2` + `mb=6`:
```
avg_step: 118ms  (was 137ms)
95th: 155ms  (was 190ms)
allreduce_avg: 15ms (was 22ms)
idle_avg: 12ms (was 25ms)
kv_spill: 0.3%
```

aj: Nice win. Can you try `mb=8` + `prefetch=2` to see if seq-boundary falls back? If still bad we need to harden kernel selector so we don't pick non-optimized kernels at boundary.

maria: `mb=8` + `prefetch=2` -> avg step 126ms, 95th 172ms; improved but still occasional drift. Logs show `cudaStreamSynchronize` waiting for allreduce in one step on host-9.

tom: Host spike smells like NCCL rendezvous fallback due to NVLink contention. Check NCCL debug logs and `/proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/*/inforom` for GPU link errors.

kelly: Short-term proposals: 1) set default `kv_prefetch=2` for pp>2, 2) add tiny randomized jitter to microbatch scheduling to de-synchronize ranks, 3) expose kernel-selection telemetry flag so we can see when a non-opt kernel is chosen.

aj: +1 on telemetry and jitter (measure throughput impact). Also add a CI perf test that reproduces the tail.

maria: I'll open a tiny RFC and roll a canary with `kern_select=streamed-gemm` + `kv_prefetch=2` + `mb=6` to a dedicated pool for 24h. Will add the CI reproducer.

tom: Please also include the NCCL debug trace and a `nvlink stat` snapshot in the RFC so infra can check link health.

maria: will attach logs. thanks all :thumbsup:
